action: Re-base the FY2022 Revenues in the model on continuing operations ($58.10B as now reported, -$18.45B vs $76.56B): the restatement removes GE HealthCare Technologies Inc. (CIK 0001932393) (8-K items 1.01,2.01,8.01,9.01, filed 2023-01-04), whose own filings report $18.34B for the period; residual: $114.0M unexplained (0.6% of the effect).
root_cause: GE HealthCare Technologies Inc. (CIK 0001932393), the separate registrant behind the disposal GE reported in its 8-K filed 2023-01-04, reports Revenues of $18.34B for FY2022; add-back: restated $58.10B + GE HealthCare Technologies Inc. $18.34B = $76.44B vs original $76.56B (gap -$114.0M, tolerance 5% = $3.83B); explains 99% of the -$18.45B restatement; residual $114.0M unexplained (0.6% of the effect); reconciled

evidence.sql:
SELECT cik, first(h._source.display_names[i]) AS name, count(*) AS hits,
       min(h._source.file_date) AS first_date, max(h._source.file_date) AS last_date,
       concat_ws(',', sort_array(collect_set(h._source.form))) AS forms,
       concat_ws(',', sort_array(array_distinct(flatten(collect_list(h._source.items))))) AS items,
       max(hits.total.value) AS total
FROM tiresias_sec.fts_2cb94942ad34f3e7_raw
LATERAL VIEW explode(hits.hits) AS h
LATERAL VIEW posexplode(h._source.ciks) AS i, cik
GROUP BY cik
ORDER BY hits DESC, cik DESC
LIMIT 20
